events.description:
Wed, Feb 4, 2026 – 4:00 pm and 7:00 pm
Galaxy Cinemas, 72 Commerce Park Drive, Barrie, ON  L4N 8W8
Tickets: $12 (includes HST)

Drama | 119 Min. | United Kingdom | PG

Directed by Philippa Lowthorpe
Starring: Claire Foy, Brendan Gleeson, Denise Gough, Sam Spruell, and Lindsay Duncan

Based on the award-winning memoir by Helen Macdonald, this biographical drama tells the true story of a woman who attempts to process the sudden death of her father by adopting and training a fierce northern goshawk. Starring Claire Foy and Brendan Gleeson, the film explores how this unconventional bond with a wild animal serves as a transformative path toward healing and resilience.

events.title: National Canadian Film Day – SOLD OUT
events.description:
Join us for a FREE screening of ATANARJUAT: THE FAST RUNNER on National Canadian Film Day! Let’s celebrate Canadian cinema together!

 

National Canadian Film Day Screening:
ATANARJUAT: THE FAST RUNNER

CANADA | 2001 | 172m | 14A
Language: Inuktitut with English subtitles
Drama

Admission: FREE

 

We have SOLD OUT!

 

TICKET REGISTRATION

 

Based on an ancient Inuit legend, Atanarjuat is an epic tale of love, betrayal, and revenge. The beautiful Atuat (Ivalu) has been promised to the short-fused Oki (Arnatsiaq), the son of the tribe’s leader. However, she loves the good-natured Atanarjuat (Ungalaaq), a fast runner and excellent hunter. When Atanarjuat is forced to battle the jealous Oki for Atuat’s hand, the events that follow determine not only his fate, but that of his people.

Atanarjuat won 26 awards, including eight Genies and the Caméra d’Or at the 2001 Cannes Film Festival. In 2015, Atanarjuat was selected as TIFF’s number one Canadian film of all time. It is the 25th Anniversary for this film.

Barrie Airshow 2026 | Outdoor screening

Friday, June 12, 2026
Meridian Place, Downtown Barrie

Directed by Joseph Kosinski

Rated PG-13 for sequences of intense action, and some strong language

 

Synopsis:
After more than thirty years of service as one of the Navy’s top aviators, Pete “Maverick” Mitchell (Tom Cruise) is where he belongs, pushing the envelope as a courageous test pilot and dodging the advancement in rank that would ground him. When he finds himself training a detachment of Top Gun graduates for a specialized mission the likes of which no living pilot has ever seen, Maverick encounters Lt. Bradley Bradshaw (Miles Teller), call sign: “Rooster,” the son of Maverick’s late friend and Radar Intercept Officer Lt. Nick Bradshaw, aka “Goose.” Facing an uncertain future and confronting the ghosts of his past, Maverick is drawn into a confrontation with his own deepest fears, culminating in a mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice from those who will be chosen to fly it.

 

Awards: Won 1 Oscar (Best Sound), 93 wins, 214 nominations!

events.title: JACK JOHNSON: SURFILMUSIC – Outdoor Screening
events.description:
Troubadour Festival | Outdoor screening

 

JACK JOHNSON: SURFILMUSIC

Friday, August 14, 2026
Meridian Place, Downtown Barrie
Admission: Free

Starts at dusk, weather permitting

 

Documentary | Not Rated | 75 min.

 

A new documentary chronicling Jack Johnson’s evolution from surfer to filmmaker to world-renowned musician. The film traces how Johnson’s early years making surf films with close friends became a foundation for a much broader creative life, capturing moments in and out of the water that later surfaced in his songwriting. Blending rare footage from those formative surf films and Johnson’s personal and family archives with present-day reflections, the film weaves together how lived experience, friendship, and exploration shaped the sound and stories behind the music.

Directed by Emmett Malloy, featuring Jack Johnson, Kelly Slater, Rob Machado, Gerry Lopez, Chris Malloy, G. Love, Ben Harper, John Florence, Emmett Malloy, Kim Johnson, and more, with a beautiful score by Jack Johnson and Hermanos Gutiérrez. In loving memory of Tamayo Perry.

 

 

Prior to the movie:

JACK JOHNSON TRIBUTE BAND with JON BRYANT, starts at 7:30 pm

Bio: Over a career spanning more than fifteen years, Jon Bryant has established himself as a master of emotional transparency. Bryant has amassed over 150 million global streams, driven by fan-favorite tracks like “Headphones,” “Light,” “Wilderness,” and “At Home.” His acclaimed discography includes landmark LPs such as Two Coasts For Comfort [2009], What Takes You [2012], Twenty Something [2017], and Cult Classic [2019], alongside celebrated EPs like Half Bad and Psychedelic Salutations. Earning praise from tastemakers such as The Line of Best Fit and Atwood Magazine, Bryant’s creative output spans beyond music into visual art and acting, with screen appearances in Riverdale, Fire Country, Tracker, and Marvel’s Sentinel of the Spaceways, as well as voicing Bitores Mendez in Capcom’s 2023 remake of Resident Evil 4. In an era dominated by algorithms and artificial polish, Bryant remains defiantly, beautifully human, crafting songs defined by grounded authenticity and raw connection.
